cve_summary: coders/psd.c in ImageMagick allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) via a crafted PSD file.
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment performs memory copying and updates the length of a string information structure based on certain conditions.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: N/A

Logic: Logic: The fragment declares pointers used for string information and image-related data. The surrounding context and subsequent processing logic are not visible in this fragment.

judge_vs_vulnerable.rationale: The candidate implementation contains a loop that processes data, performs string comparisons, and manipulates memory, while the reference implementation only declares variables without any processing logic. These are fundamentally different in behavior and purpose, making them non-equivalent.

judge_vs_fixed.rationale: The two implementations are nearly identical, with the only difference being the variable name used for the destination pointer in the CopyMagickMemory call (v2 in the candidate vs. q in the reference). This is a superficial difference and does not affect the behavior of the code. Both implementations perform the same memory copy and string length update logic under the same conditions.
